name: AzInTelecom Absheron Main Data Center, Modules M1-M5
notes: State Government Cloud green data center. Uptime Institute lists locality as Gobustan while EIB/AZERTAC/AzInTelecom project-region language is Absheron (record both). Uptime Tier III Design certification (2022/2024); AZERTAC 2024-07-31 confirms 'TIER 3 Design' cert for the two new AzInTelecom DCs and preparatory work; EIB Global EUR 43m loan (2024, due 2027) covers both Absheron (main) and Hajigabul (reserve) sites - do not assign full financing to one site. Trend/ANS 2025-10-09 quote AzInTelecom commercial director that construction of the two new DCs started in 2025; tech.az targets completion by 2030. No capacity disclosed; MVA/MW not inferred.

name: Sumgait Technologies Data Center (STDC)
notes: Commercial colocation / AI-cloud / HPC data center in Sumgayit (Chemical Industrial Park context per AZ methodology; presidential/AZERTAC report leads). Operator official site stdc.az markets active colocation, AI Cloud and blockchain services (news dated Dec 2024), confirming operational status; engineering-design page for 'Sumqayit Texnologiyalar Data Merkezi' on Baku-Guba road 37th km and Opal Steel construction portfolio corroborate facility. No Uptime certification or capacity (MW) located in this run - capacity null, grade B pending operator/certification hardening.
